title: zazzle-llm component diagram
description: The zazzle-llm crate: one binary in src/, the zazzled that downloads and execs it for `zazzle agent llm|prompt`, llama.cpp, which it links to run the models, and Hugging Face, from which it downloads them.

components.name: zazzle-llm
components.responsibility: The package and its binary zazzle-llm, with the `metal` feature for Apple Silicon.

components.name: zazzle-llm sources
components.responsibility: The command line, the model catalogue, the model store and its downloads, chat templates, the thinking splitter and the llama.cpp engine.

components.name: zazzled
components.responsibility: `zazzled llm ARGS` finds zazzle-llm beside itself or downloads and verifies it (JIT tools), then execs it with the arguments.

components.name: llama.cpp (llama-cpp-2)
components.responsibility: Loads GGUF models and decodes tokens on the CPU, or the GPU through Metal on Apple Silicon; compiled into the binary.

components.name: Hugging Face
components.responsibility: Hosts the model files; zazzle-llm downloads each one over HTTPS at the commit its catalogue pins.

relationships.description: Execs the zazzle-llm binary beside it or from its tool store.
engine.rs loads the model, tokenizes, decodes and samples through llama-cpp-2.
store.rs downloads a model file with ureq, resuming with HTTP Range.
